blocks.name: Small Business Execution Certificate of Completion (NC)

notes: Measure recorded as hours: this is a noncredit Certificate of Completion. The catalog labels the column 'Unit(s)' and says 'credits', but values such as 9 and 18 are consistent with noncredit hours. A reviewer should confirm.

The catalog prints each value as a range with 0 as the second number ('9 - 0', '36-0'). This looks like a display artifact for noncredit courses, so I recorded the first number and left units_max null.

The catalog states 'Complete the following number of credits: 36', but the four listed courses total 45 (9+9+9+18). I recorded the block as choose_units with a minimum of 36. Possibly students take only one of OFFTB65AN Product Design or OFFTB65BN Service Creation, but the text does not say so.

The catalog prints codes without a space (e.g., 'OFFTB81NC'). OFFTB81NC matches the closed-list OFFT B81NC and is not marked as a catalog addition. OFFTB65AN, OFFTB65BN and OFFTB76NC are not on the closed list.
The source URL slug references 'summer-2022', although the catalog is labeled 2026-2027.
